subject: TELEMETRY CONTRACT: expose physical INNER power/presentation state in-app; command success must not masquerade as visible pixels
body: Human requested an in-app indicator because the Fold7 closes too tightly to visually verify whether INNER is actually powered. Add a user-visible diagnostic/status parameter without granting it routing authority. Required staged vocabulary: INNER_WAKE_IDLE / REQUESTED / COMMAND_ACCEPTED / PHYSICAL_POWER_CONFIRMED_OR_UNKNOWN / BRIDGE_PRESENTING / NATIVE_LOGICAL_AVAILABLE / NATIVE_ACTIVE / PRESENTATION_UNKNOWN. Cover should expose analogous physical state where available. The existing physicalPowered=true receipt means the privileged SurfaceControl mutation returned successfully; it is not sufficient proof that OLED pixels are emitting. Prefer a shell-side post-command confirmation from SurfaceFlinger/dumpsys/display-device state when reliably queryable, and keep that separate from FIRST_PRESENTED/FIRST_USEFUL optical/presentation evidence. The UI should show a concise summary such as 'INNER: physical wake accepted - waiting for native display' while retaining detailed stage/timestamp data in diagnostics. Also expose current opening source (HALL, DEVICE_STATE, PRECISE_HINGE, FALLBACK) and OpeningKey for field correlation. This requirement is observational only and must not change hinge geometry, rendering math, privacy, or display ownership.
